hazards.control: Lockout the prime mover and brake the unit before anyone approaches the beam, cranks, or belts.

name: Counterweights
function: Cast weights on the cranks positioned so the unit lifts the rod string and fluid on the upstroke with the same torque it lifts the weights on the downstroke.

tabs.overview: Moved along the crank to balance; checked with a dynamometer or motor current.
tabs.safety: Heavy rotating mass; never adjusted without the brake set and the cranks chocked.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
